tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (nga )༄༅/ /khros ma nag mo gsang sgrub kyi gtor dbang dngos grub dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas kya
(nga )༄༅/ /khros ma nag mo gsang sgrub kyi gtor dbang dngos grub dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti/rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas kya

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// khros ma nag mo gsang sgrub kyi gtor dbang dngos grub dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas kyi bka' srol rdo rje phag mo gsang sgrub khros ma nag mo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la/ bsham bkod ni/ stegs bu chang dang bdud rtsis chag chag btab la/ dkyil 'khor lte ba zlum po'i nang du chos 'byung sngon po zur mdun bstan gyi dbus su bam̐ yig nag po/ de'i phyogs bzhir padma 'dab bzhir phyogs mdog la ha ri ni sa bri/ mtha' rdor me ris bskor ba'o// de'i dbus su mañdzi'i steng du gtor ma nag po rtse zlum stod zur gsum pa dar nag po'i gdugs phub pa zhig dang*/ phyogs bzhir gtor chung dkar zlum bzhi/ shar du khros ma'i lha tsaka lhor bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa/ nub tu me long la sindhu ra bkram ste chos 'byung rkyang pa rdo rwa me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su bam̐ la ha ri ni sas bskor ba bris pa/ byang du sgrub thabs kyi glegs bam rnams bkod/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ gzhan yang nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o// de nas sgrub mchod ni/ sngon gtor dkar dmar gnyis bshams pa bsang sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥs byis gyis brlab/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas phaiṃ zhes mgron dgug gtor ma dmar po de oṃ ḍā ka ḍā ki kṣe tra pā la da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ mkha' 'gro zhing skyong phyogs skyong sogs srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul lo// bdag cag dpon slob 'gal rkyen sol mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod/ ces phul/ dkar gtor de a kā ros lan gsum gyis gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul lo// gnod pa'i bsam sbyor spangs la phan bde'i bsam pas bdag gi stong grogs mdzod cig ces phyir dor zhing nag phyogs rnams sumbha'i drag sngags kyis bskrad do// de nas bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par bsams la/

'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs dang*/ shes rab snying rje sogs kyis skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ yan lag bdun pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod pa bla na med pas mchod// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bdag gis dge ba ci bsags pa// sems can kun la bsngo bar bgyi// tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ nang mchod la/ srin lag gis chos 'byung 'bri tshul bya zhing*/ dam rdzas 'bar ba'i snod du chos 'byung gi dbus su padma 'dab bzhi la ha ri ni sa gsal bar gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la thim pas zhu zhing 'dres pa las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes byin gyis brlab/ de las g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod blangs te oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes rang lus la gtor zhing khrus byas pas bdag dang rnal 'byor bsrung*/ phyogs g.yon dang mtshams g.yas skor gyis bdud rtsi 'thor zhing sumbha lan gnyis brjod pas/ bdud rtsi'i zegs ma ḍā ki'i sprin du gyur pas bgegs thams cad bskrad/ gzhom med bsrung ba'i 'khor los phyogs thams cad bcings par bsam pa ni gnas bsrung ba'o// de nas mchod rdzas rnams bsang*/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su hūm̐ yig zhu ba las mchod rdzas rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shabda'i bar brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas dngos gzhi ni/ shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyi bdag dang mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyis mtshon pa'i chos thams cad stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang lus srung 'khor dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang gi nang du padma 'dab bzhi chos 'byung gi lte bar pad nyi ro gdan dang bcas par gyur/

rang sems lha'i 'khor lor rdzogs pa ni/ gdan gyi steng bam̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog nag mo rtsa zhal kun rdzob rnam par dag pa khro mo'i zhal dang*/ steng zhal don dam rnam par dag pa phag gdong g.yas phyogs nas gyen du phyogs pa las phag skad sngags kyi sgrar sgrogs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thug kar 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i cha byad lngas brgyan cing smyon pa'i cha byad can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis mi ro'i snying ga nas brdzis pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba/ snying gar yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gri thod kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa la yi dam thams cad kyis bskor ba/ pho bar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar phyag rdor sngon po rdor dril 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang pa'i dor stabs can/ rtsibs bzhi'i shar du ra las yul 'khor srung dkar po g.yas pi waṃ/ lhor tsa las 'phags skyes po sngon po g.yas ral gri/ nub tu tri las mig mi bzang dmar po g.yas bu chung gi ro/ byang du yam̐ las rnam sras ljang gu g.yas mchod rten/ bzhi ka g.yon rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dgos 'dod ster ba'o// lte bar padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su rang 'dra ba'i rje btsun khros ma nag mo/ 'dab bzhi'i shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo g.yas rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i gri gug lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo g.yas rin po che'i gri gug nub tu ni las padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo g.yas padma'i gri gug byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu g.yas rgya gram gyi gri gug g.yon thams cad thod khrag 'dzin pa'o// de ltar gnyug ma'i sems nyid lha'i 'khor lor rdzogs pa/

de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gdod ma nyid nas rang bzhin dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid chen por rnam par dag par gyur/ de ltar gsal ba'i ngang nas lus gnad bca' zhing skabs skabs su lto ba phul ba dang g.yon du bskor/ rlung steng 'og kha sbyar la yid bzlas bya/ sems bde stong gi nyams la che re blta/ yid chos nyid kyi ngang la ma yengs par 'jog cing dran pa bzhis bskul btab la bzlas par bya ste/ spyi bo'i bla ma dran pas/ ha ri ni sa e raṃ zhes bzla/ snying ga'i yi dam dran pas/ ha ri ni sa ya na te/ zhes bzla/ lte ba'i mkha' 'gro dran pas/ ha ri ni sa e 'du/ zhes bzla/ pho ba'i chos skyong dran la/ ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzla'o// 'dir bdag mdun dbyer med du sgrub cing bzla ba'i lugs yin pas mdun bskyed logs su sgrub mi dgos so// de ltar ci nus bzlas mthar mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra wā rā hī sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul nas/ padma nyi ma rtog med gdan la gar mdzad cing*// mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras// khros pa'i phag skad 'gros kyis 'gro rnams dbang du sdud// rdo rje phag mo bde ba'i stobs ldan khyod la bstod// rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// phyag na rdo rje phyogs skyong rgyal chen bzhi// rdo rje phag mo las bzhi sgrub byed pa'i// mkha' 'gro rnams la sgo gsum gus pas bstod// ces bstod/ de nas gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i steng du a las ka pā la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba/ steng du zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas 'bar ba'i rgya dang bcas phaiṃ zhes brjod pas gtor mgron rnams spyan drangs la/

oṃ gu ru badzra yo gi nī badzra pā ṇi shrī badzra wā rā hī ma hā yo gi nī ha ri ni sa ra tsa tri yaṃ i daṃ ba liṃ ta sogs sbyar bas phyogs gtor bzhi po mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang rgyal po sde bzhi la phul/ thun mong du/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ bcom ldan rdo rje phag mo chen mo ni// 'jig rten gsum dang phyogs gzhan rgol ba 'joms// rmongs byed skrag byed rengs par byed pa mo// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma bde gshegs yi dam lha// ma dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// phyag 'tshal bstod cing gus pas mchod// rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma 'bul// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ tshogs mchod ni bla med ma rgyud kyi cho ga spyi ltar bya'o// de nas dbang bskur ba la gnyis las dang po slob dpon bdag 'jug ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i slob ma la ji ltar bya ba ltar bdag 'jug dbang bskur ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul du blang*/ gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ slob bu rnams khrus dang phyag byas gral du 'khod pa la/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs dang chos bshad ci rigs sngon du 'gro bas/ 'dir bla na med pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud dang rjes su 'brel ba/ de la'ang rgyud lung man ngag gsum las/ man ngag gi rjes su 'brang ba ḍā ki ma snying gi dum bu drug cu rtsa bzhi zhes bka' srung mkha' 'gro sde bzhis rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas la gsungs pa'i khros ma nag mo'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba la slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ da khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog mar maṇḍal phul mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes lan gnyis kyis mig dar dang me tog gtad/

de nas bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes= /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// rnal 'byor ma dpal dgongs su gsol// byang chub sems las rmad byung ba'i// sdom pa rgya mtsho bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum/ de nas bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar sad par mos la 'di'i= /bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// mchod pa bla na med pas mchod// sdig pa mi dge so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs su gsol// bdag gis dge ba ci bsags pa// sems can kun la bsngo bar bgyi// lan gsum/ de nas spyi dang khyad par gyi sdom pa mtha' dag bzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes= /sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma tshogs kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis deng nas byang chub bar// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// thar pa 'dod phyir skyabs su mchi// sems can kun don bsgrub pa'i phyir// byang chub sems gsum bskyed par bgyi// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*// bcu bzhir phye ba'i ltung ba dang*// yan lag nyes pa spang bar bgyi// lan gsum/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dkyil 'khor du bcug par mos la yol ba bsal/ dam bzhag ni/ bdud rtsi blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// a mṛ ta u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hūm̐/ de nas khyed rang mnyam pa'i stabs kyis langs la thal mo spyi bor sbyor/ ngag rlung kha sbyor du 'chings/ sems kyi gnas lugs rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ rtsa zhal khro mo/ g.yas zhal phag gdong gri gug dang thod khrag bsnams pa/

zhabs gar stabs ling ling bsgyur ba zhig tu lam gyis bskyed la bla ma la mos gus drag po byas pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas khyed rang la thim par mos la sems 'dzin med kyi ngang du khres se bsgyur la zhog cig spos rol dang bcas pas ha ri ni sa ā be sha ya a zhes drag tu dbab/ de nas rnal 'byor ma'i sku la me tog phul bar mos la 'di'i rjes= oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥzhes me tog dor/ de nyid spyi bor bcings par mos la/ oṃ pra ti gṛhna st+waṃ i maṃ sa twa mahā ba la/ de nas dzñā na tsakṣu maṇḍa la dzñā na pra be sha ya phaṭa/ ces mig dar bsal/ he badzra pa shya/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du thong bar gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas dbang bskur ba dngos la bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang zhu ba'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes= /bla ma rin po che/ bdag la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sgrub kyi bum pa'i dbang stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis shar gyi tsa ka li'i sku mig tu bstan cing lag tu gtad la/ khyed rnams lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa bor la/ deng phyin chad mkha' 'gro ma 'di yi dam du bzung la/ 'di ltar sgom pa la snang stong zhen bral du bskyangs bar gyis shig des bum dbang thob pas lha sku bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// de nas gsang dbang zhu ba'i slad du 'di'i rjes= /bla ma rin po che/ bdag la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sgrub gsang ba'i dbang stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ lho'i bdud rtsi thogs te khyed kyi ngag tha mal du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan bde mchog yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dis byin gyis brlabs pas/ deng phyin chad ngag rje btsun ma'i sngags su shes par gyis la grags stong zhen med du skyong bar mdzod cig byas la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes bdud rtsi hub gsum 'thung du gzhug des gsang dbang thob pas rlung sngags bzlas sgom la dbang bar byas pa yin no// de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i slad du 'di'i rjes= bla ma rin po che/ bdag la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sgrub kyi shes rab ye shes kyi dbang stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ nub kyi sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor ston cing*/ khyed kyi yid kyi dri ma dag par byed pa la/ sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi yi ge 'di rnams rnal 'byor ma dngos yin/ de thim pas 'di rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa las bde stong gi nyams khyad par can dang ma bral bar mdzod/ sngags 'di rnal 'byor ma yi gzugs// rnal 'byor ma yang sngags kyi gzugs// dngos grub go 'phang mchog 'dod na// de 'dra tha dad mi blta'o// zhes brjod cing*/ sindhū ra g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs la slob ma'i gnas bzhir thig le bya'o// des sher dbang thob pas zhu bde sgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// de nas dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i slad du 'di'i rjes= bla ma rin po che/ bdag la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang stsal du gsol/ lan gsum/ byang gi sgrub thabs kyi dpe mgo thog tu bzhag nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos sgrub thams cad dpe 'di nas bshad pa bzhin nyams su blangs na/ 'byung pas tshul bzhin du nyams su long la/ sems nyid rtsa bral gyi don rtogs par mdzod cig de nas dpon slob gnyis ka khros ma nag mo zhal gnyis ma gri thod bsnams pa g.yas brkyang gi gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ snying gar rnal 'byor ma dmar mo la yi dam gyis bskor ba/ lte bar padma 'dab bzhir khros nag rang 'dra ba la mkha' 'gro sde bzhis bskor ba/ pho bar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi par/ phyag rdor la rgyal chen sde bzhis bskor ba rnams gsal thob/

de nas dran pa bzhi dang ldan pas sngags kyi rjes zlos byas pa'i tshe bla ma'i gnas so so las 'od zer byung ba slob ma'i gnas de dang der thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos la/ dang po spyi bo'i bla ma dran pas 'di'i rjes= ha ri ni sa e raṃ/ snying ga'i yi dam dran pas 'di'i rjes= ha ri ni sa yin te/ lte ba'i mkha' 'gro dran pas 'di'i rjes= ha ri ni sa e 'du/ pho ba'i chos skyong dran pas 'di'i rjes= ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sngags rnams lan gsum re bzla'o// khyed rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'jug par gyur cig ces me tog 'thor/ des dbang bzhi pa thob pas de kho na nyid bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// de nas gtor ma la brten nas byin gyis rlobs pa'i slad du gtor snod dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang gi nang du padma 'dab bzhi chos 'byung gi lte bar pad nyi ro gdan dang bcas pa'i steng du bam̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog nag mo rtsa zhal kun rdzob rnam par dag pa khro mo'i zhal dang*/ steng zhal don dam rnam par dag pa phag gdong g.yas phyogs nas gyen du phyogs pa las phag skad sngags kyi sgrar sgrogs pa/ spyan gsum ma/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i cha byad lngas brgyan cing smyon pa'i cha byad can/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis mi ro'i snying ga nas brdzis pa/ me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba/ snying gar yi dam rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gri thod kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa la yi dam thams cad kyis bskor ba/ pho bar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar phyag rdor sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa g.yon brkyang ba'i dor stabs can/

rtsibs bzhi'i shar du ra las yul 'khor srung dkar po g.yas pi waṃ/ lhor tsa las 'phags skyes po sngon po g.yas ral gri/ nub tu tri las mig mi 'dzum dmar po g.yas bu chung gi ro/ byang du ya las rnam sras ljang gu g.yas mchod rten/ bzhi ka g.yon rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dgos 'dod ster ba/ lte bar padma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su rang 'dra ba'i rje btsun khros ma nag mo/ 'dab bzhi'i shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog sngon mo g.yas rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i gri gug lhor ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo g.yas rin po che'i gri gug nub tu ni las padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo g.yas padma'i gri gug byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu g.yas rgya gram gyi gri gug g.yon thams cad thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi phyogs mtshams steng 'og rnams su'ang bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mu med pa dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku lus bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad dag sku gsum ye shes lnga'i dbang dang dngos grub thams cad thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig hūm̐/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang*// skal ldan rigs kyi bu la bskur ba yis// lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa kun dag nas// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru bam̐ ha ri ni sa siddhi hūm̐/ oṃ shrī badzra wā rā hī kro dhī kā lī ḍā ki nī bam̐ ha ri ni sa ā we sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod bzhin du gtor ma spyi bo/ snying ga lte ba/ pho ba rnams su bzhag mthar gtor ma lhar gsal ba khyed rang la thim pas rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs dang khyed rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ mjug chog dam tshig khas len maṇḍal lus longs spyod 'bul ba rnams dang*/

sgrub thabs kyi mjug chog mchod bstod bzod gsol brtan bzhugs gshegs gsol gang 'os spyi ltar byas nas/ rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang la thim/ de rang la thim/ de bam̐ la thim/ de thig le la thim/ de nā da la thim/ nā da'ang mi dmigs par gyur/ slar yang rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa'i gnas rnams su/ oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yom̐/ hriṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces go cha bsgo/ spro na/ de'i lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar po rdo rje phag mo sogs bdag bskyed ltar bya/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ sogs hūm̐ bzhi pa tshar gnyis kyis phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor du se gol gtogs te bsrung*/ bsngo smon bkra shis spyi ltar bya'o// zhes pa 'di ni lo chen dharma shrīs mdzad pa'i zhi byed lugs kyi phag mo'i byin rlabs rnams las rje bla ma'i bka'i dgongs pa bzhin du gsang sgrub khros nag gi byin rlabs zur du phyung zhing gtor dbang kha 'gengs bcas bklags chog tu blo gter dbang pos bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
